judgement.one_sentence_verdict: A pleasant, well-lit sky with delicate cirrus and a striking contrail, but it lacks the drama or color of a truly memorable sky photo.
strengths: sweeping cirrus texture across a strong blue sky
the contrail adds a clear vertical focal line
weaknesses: the contrail is artificial and dominates the scene
lower cloud band is fairly flat gray
houses and trees slightly distract at the horizon
